mentions.name: Swift SpriteKit iOS/macOS game
mentions.description: A game for iOS and macOS built with Swift and SpriteKit, developed in spare time as a practice project using Claude Code; gameplay mechanics were implemented as requested and the base game is playable without bugs, though UI elements like menu screens resisted prompting and the codebase is not professional quality.
mentions.source_excerpt: So the past few weekends and the occasional week night I've been vibe-coding a game for iOS/MacOS using Swift and SpriteKit.
